官方简介: SurrealDB is an AI-native, multi-model database that unifies document, graph, relational, time-series, geospatial and key-value data types in one powerful engine. Built in Rust, it provides powerful search and retrieval - vectors, full-text, hybrid - and built-in real-time and event-driven capabilities. Using SurrealDB, companies can build production-ready AI agents using one data layer for agent context, memory and semantic retrieval, drastically reducing complexity and deploying agents faster.
